## MilView nationality (`MilView.nationality`)

A large ISO-3166-derived set of the form `NATIONALITY_<COUNTRY>` (e.g.
`NATIONALITY_UNITED_STATES_OF_AMERICA`, `NATIONALITY_UNITED_KINGDOM`, `NATIONALITY_FRANCE`,
`NATIONALITY_AUSTRALIA`). Introspect the installed SDK for the full list.
